answer_1.quote: The task of graph-to-text generation aims to automatically produce natural language descriptions of knowledge graphs...
answer_1.outputs: generated natural language sentences describing input knowledge‑graph subgraphs

answer_2.quote: we also report automatic evaluation results using standard natural language generation metrics BLEU, METEOR and chrF++.

answer_4.quote: Three human annotators evaluated the quality of the graph-sentence pairs in GraphNarrative... each human annotator scored all 200 pairs using the metrics in Section 6.2. We shuffled the 200 pairs and used three human evaluators to score the pairs.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored hallucinated entities, missed entities, hallucinated relations, missed relations, and grammar errors per sentence.
